capabilities: Bold the first letters of words in Reading view with adjustable strength and minimum length
Toggle the effect with a command or a per-note fixation property
Exclude notes, folders, and tags from the effect
Enable word-start emphasis in Live Preview via editor decorations
Customize emphasis weight, color, and ending opacity
disambiguation: Not a speed-reading or comprehension tool; it only changes text display and makes no claim about reading speed or health.
extras: Freemium: Reading view, strength/length controls, toggle command, and single-note exclusion are free; Live Preview, folder/tag exclusions, and custom styles require Pro. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4+. After updates it opens a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat (can be turned off). README notes untested platforms (Linux, Windows, mobile, screen readers) and that Pro payment checks were only tested locally.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to add visual word-start emphasis to rendered prose for easier reading of long notes.
